say:2:1536122501:1.source_cn: 当然是因为赶上猎血节啦！

say:3:1536122502:1.text: The warriors bring their kills back. Everyone gets a share!
say:3:1536122502:1.source_cn: 猎血节的战士会把打到的猎物带回山谷，分给大家！
say:3:1536122502:1.male: The warriors bring their kills back. Everyone gets a share!
say:3:1536122502:1.female: The warriors bring their kills back. Everyone gets a share!

say:4:1536122503:1.text: The Hunting Goddess' blessing kept us fed all these years!
say:4:1536122503:1.source_cn: 多亏狩猎神的庇佑，我们这些年从没挨过饿！
say:4:1536122503:1.male: The Hunting Goddess' blessing kept us fed all these years!
say:4:1536122503:1.female: The Hunting Goddess' blessing kept us fed all these years!
